title: Avila Core Trust Root v0.1 draft
description: The requester and runner public keys one `avila-core run --trust-root FILE` invocation accepts (ADR-0015). Supplied from outside the case package; a package cannot extend or replace its own trust root. A key id is listed only under the role(s) it is trusted for: a key present only as `runner` never satisfies a check that requires `requester`.

key_id.description: The SHA-256 of the public key bytes, hex encoded.
